records.literal_gloss: And behold, one having come to him said, Teacher, what good shall I do that I may have life eternal?

en.L: And look, someone came to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and said, "Teacher, what good [thing] must I do so that I may have eternal life?"
en.B: Then a man came up to Jesus and asked, "Teacher, what good thing must I do to gain eternal life?"
en.R: One day a man came to Jesus and asked, "Teacher, what good thing must I do to have eternal life?"

es.L: Y mira, uno se acercó a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} y dijo: «Maestro, ¿qué [cosa] buena debo hacer para tener vida eterna?».
es.B: Entonces un hombre se acercó a Jesús y le preguntó: «Maestro, ¿qué cosa buena tengo que hacer para obtener la vida eterna?».
es.R: Un día, un hombre fue a ver a Jesús y le preguntó: «Maestro, ¿qué cosa buena tengo que hacer para tener vida eterna?».

fr.L: Et voici que quelqu’un, s’étant approché de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, dit : « Maître, que dois-je faire de bon pour avoir la vie éternelle ? »
fr.B: Alors un homme s’approcha de Jésus et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} demanda : « Maître, quelle bonne action dois-je accomplir pour obtenir la vie éternelle ? »
fr.R: Un jour, un homme est venu voir Jésus et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a demandé : « Maître, qu’est-ce que je dois faire de bien pour avoir la vie éternelle ? »

sw.L: Na tazama, mtu mmoja alimjia, akasema, "Mwalimu, nifanye [jambo] gani jema ili nipate uzima wa milele?"
sw.B: Kisha mtu mmoja alimjia Yesu, akamwuliza, "Mwalimu, ni jambo gani jema ninalopaswa kufanya ili nipate uzima wa milele?"
sw.R: Siku moja mtu mmoja alimwendea Yesu, akamwuliza, "Mwalimu, nifanye jambo gani jema ili niwe na uzima wa milele?"

vi.L: Và kìa, có một người đến gần {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và nói: "Thưa Thầy, tôi phải làm điều tốt nào để có sự sống đời đời?"
vi.B: Bấy giờ có một người đến hỏi Đức Giê-xu: "Thưa Thầy, tôi phải làm điều tốt gì để được sự sống đời đời?"
vi.R: Một hôm, có một người đến hỏi Đức Giê-xu: "Thưa Thầy, tôi phải làm việc tốt nào để có được sự sống đời đời?"

ko.L: 그리고 보라, 어떤 사람이 그분께 나아와 말했다. "선생님, 제가 영원한 생명을 가지려면 무슨 선한 일을 해야 합니까?"
ko.B: 그때에 어떤 사람이 예수께 다가와서 물었다. "선생님, 영원한 생명을 얻으려면 제가 무슨 선한 일을 해야 합니까?"
ko.R: 어느 날 한 사람이 예수께 와서 여쭈었다. "선생님, 영원한 생명을 얻으려면 제가 어떤 선한 일을 해야 합니까?"

pt.L: E eis que alguém se aproximou {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} e disse: "Mestre, que [coisa] boa devo fazer para ter a vida eterna?"
pt.B: Então um homem se aproximou de Jesus e perguntou: "Mestre, que boa ação devo fazer para alcançar a vida eterna?"
pt.R: Um dia, um homem foi até Jesus e perguntou: "Mestre, que coisa boa eu preciso fazer para ter a vida eterna?"

decisions.choice: eternal life: the life of the age to come, life with God that does not end
decisions.reason: Daniel 12:2 speaks of those who will rise "to everlasting life". In 19:17 the same life is called simply "life", and in 19:23-24 entering it is entering the kingdom.

decisions.choice: what good thing must I do: he thinks of a deed that will earn life
decisions.reason: He asks what single good act is needed. Jesus's answer turns him from good deeds to the one who is good.

decisions.choice: Teacher, the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: Good Teacher, the reading of many later manuscripts
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts read "Good Teacher", as in Mark 10:17 and Luke 18:18. See the note on 19:17. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: look (L); then (B); one day (R) (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:20, Literal uses "look" and Balanced and Readable carry the word's force in the flow of the sentence.

decisions.choice: a man
decisions.reason: Matthew says only "one"; he is later called a young man (19:20) and rich (19:22).

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans only on separate pronouns and possessives (él, le, te, me, su, mi)
decisions.reason: Spanish usually leaves the subject pronoun out and joins some object pronouns to the verb ("sígueme", "seguirte"), where there is nothing separate to capitalise. So the setting covers fewer words than in English, as in Mark 16. This holds for the whole passage.

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple (L, B) and the passé composé (R); Matthew's historic presents kept as presents at Literal ("dit", 19:18, 19:20)
decisions.reason: As in Mark and Luke: the passé simple is the normal tense of written narrative and suits a careful public reading; the passé composé is how French is spoken and how young readers meet stories, so Readable uses it throughout. Speech keeps its own tenses at every level.

decisions.choice: Maître for "Teacher" in address at every level
decisions.reason: As Mark 10:17: French addresses a respected teacher as "Maître"; "Enseignant" or "Professeur" would sound like a school. The question about doing good shows that a teacher, not an owner, is meant.

decisions.choice: uzima wa milele (every level)
decisions.reason: The term used across the New Testament drafts, as in John: "uzima" is life itself, the life of the age to come (meaning decision m1), where "maisha" would be a lifetime or daily living.

decisions.choice: "Thưa Thầy" and "tôi" in the man's words; Jesus calls him "anh" (19:16-22)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 10:17-21: a man who calls him Teacher and is not a disciple speaks as "tôi"; Jesus answers a young man as "anh".

decisions.choice: "보라" (L), not rendered (B, R); no deity_pronoun spans in Korean, through Matthew 19:16-30
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Matthew, Literal keeps the narrator's "behold" as "보라". Korean has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change; the man speaks to Jesus in 합쇼체 (style guide, sections 4 and 7).

decisions.choice: "선생님" for didaskale; "영원한 생명" at every level
decisions.reason: "영원한 생명" is the style guide's term (section 6), as in the Korean Mark 10:17.

decisions.choice: eis que
decisions.reason: As at 17:3: Literal gives the Greek "behold" as "eis que", Portuguese's own narrative word for it; Balanced and Readable carry its force in "Então", "Um dia".

source.text: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Τί με ἐρωτᾷς περὶ τοῦ ἀγαθοῦ;

records.literal_gloss: He but said to him, Why me do you ask about the good?

en.L: But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to him, "Why do you ask {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} about what is good?
en.B: Jesus answered him, "Why ask {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} about what is good?
en.R: Jesus said to him, "Why are you asking {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} what is good?

es.L: Pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} le dijo: «¿Por qué {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} preguntas acerca de lo bueno?
es.B: Jesús le respondió: «¿Por qué {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} preguntas sobre lo que es bueno?
es.R: Jesús le dijo: «¿Por qué {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} preguntas qué es bueno?

fr.L: Mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lui dit : « Pourquoi {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}interroges-tu au sujet de ce qui est bon ?
fr.B: Jésus lui répondit : « Pourquoi {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}interroger sur ce qui est bon ?
fr.R: Jésus lui a dit : « Pourquoi est-ce que tu {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} demandes ce qui est bon ?

sw.L: Naye akamwambia, "Kwa nini unaniuliza kuhusu lililo jema?
sw.B: Yesu alimjibu, "Kwa nini unaniuliza kuhusu kilicho chema?
sw.R: Yesu alimwambia, "Kwa nini unaniuliza kilicho chema?

vi.L: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với người ấy: "Sao anh hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} về điều tốt?
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu đáp: "Sao anh lại hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} về điều tốt?
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói với người ấy: "Tại sao anh hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} điều gì là tốt?

ko.L: 그러나 그분이 그에게 말씀하셨다. "어찌하여 너는 선한 것에 대하여 나에게 묻느냐?
ko.B: 예수께서 그에게 대답하셨다. "왜 너는 무엇이 선한지를 나에게 묻느냐?
ko.R: 예수께서 그에게 말씀하셨다. "왜 너는 무엇이 선한 일인지 나에게 묻느냐?

pt.L: Mas {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhe disse: "Por que você pergunta a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} sobre o que é bom?
pt.B: Jesus lhe respondeu: "Por que perguntar a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} sobre o que é bom?
pt.R: Jesus disse a ele: "Por que você está perguntando a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} o que é bom?

decisions.choice: Why do you ask me about what is good? the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: Why do you call me good? the reading of many later manuscripts
decisions.reason: The earliest manuscripts of Matthew have this wording. Many later manuscripts read "Why do you call me good?", with "Good Teacher" in 19:16, as in Mark 10:17-18 and Luke 18:18-19, most likely made to agree with those Gospels. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: what is good: goodness is defined by God, not by a deed of one's choosing
alternatives: Jesus refuses to talk about goodness
decisions.reason: Jesus turns the man's question about a good deed toward God, who alone is good and who has already said what is good in his commands (Micah 6:8).

decisions.choice: pergunta a mim
decisions.reason: The Greek puts "me" first for weight; Portuguese gives that weight with the stressed "a mim" after the verb, which also carries the deity_pronoun span more naturally than a capitalised clitic before the verb.

source.text: εἷς ἐστιν ὁ ἀγαθός· εἰ δὲ θέλεις εἰς τὴν ζωὴν εἰσελθεῖν, τήρησον τὰς ἐντολάς.

en.L: One is the good [one]; but if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments."
en.B: There is one who is good. If you wish to enter into life, obey the commandments."
en.R: Only God is good. If you want to have eternal life, obey God's commands."

es.L: Uno es el bueno; pero si quieres entrar en la vida, guarda los mandamientos».
es.B: Hay uno que es bueno. Si quieres entrar en la vida, obedece los mandamientos».
es.R: Solo Dios es bueno. Si quieres tener vida eterna, obedece los mandamientos de Dios».

fr.L: Un seul est le bon ; mais si tu veux entrer dans la vie, garde les commandements. »

sw.L: Mmoja ndiye aliye mwema; lakini kama unataka kuingia uzimani, zishike amri."

vi.L: Chỉ có một [Đấng] là tốt lành; nhưng nếu anh muốn vào sự sống, hãy giữ các điều răn."
vi.B: Chỉ có một Đấng là tốt lành. Nếu anh muốn vào sự sống, hãy vâng giữ các điều răn."
vi.R: Chỉ có Đức Chúa Trời là tốt lành. Nếu anh muốn có sự sống đời đời, hãy vâng giữ các điều răn của Đức Chúa Trời."

ko.L: 선한 분은 한 분이시다. 그러나 네가 생명에 들어가고 싶으면, 계명들을 지켜라."
ko.B: 선한 분은 오직 한 분뿐이시다. 네가 생명에 들어가기를 원하면 계명을 지켜라."
ko.R: 오직 하나님만 선하시다. 네가 영원한 생명을 얻고 싶으면, 하나님의 계명을 지켜라."

pt.L: Um só é o bom; mas, se você quer entrar na vida, guarde os mandamentos."
pt.B: Só há um que é bom. Se você quer entrar na vida, obedeça aos mandamentos."
pt.R: Só Deus é bom. Se você quer ter a vida eterna, obedeça aos mandamentos de Deus."

decisions.choice: one is good: God
decisions.reason: Mark 10:18 and Luke 18:19 say "no one is good except God alone". The "one" recalls the confession that the LORD is one (Deuteronomy 6:4).

decisions.choice: enter into life: receive eternal life (19:16)
decisions.reason: As in 18:8-9, "life" stands for the life of the age to come.

decisions.choice: One is good, the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: No one is good except one, God, the reading of many later manuscripts
decisions.reason: Later manuscripts give the wording of Mark 10:18 here; see the note on 19:17. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: Only God is good; have eternal life
decisions.reason: Readable names God and says which life is meant (19:16).

decisions.choice: "một [Đấng]" (L), "một Đấng" (B); "Đức Chúa Trời" (R)
decisions.reason: The one who is good is God; "Đấng" marks a divine person without naming him, as the Greek does not; Readable names him, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "điều răn" for the commandments
decisions.reason: The style guide's word, as in Mark 10:19.

decisions.choice: "선한 분은 한 분이시다" (L, B); "오직 하나님만 선하시다" (R)
decisions.reason: The one who is good is God (meaning decision); Literal and Balanced leave him unnamed as the Greek does, and the honorific "이시다" shows who is meant. Readable names him, as the English Readable does.

vi.L: Người ấy nói với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Những điều nào?"
vi.B: Người ấy hỏi: "Những điều răn nào?"
vi.R: Người ấy hỏi: "Những điều răn nào ạ?"

ko.R: 그 사람이 여쭈었다. "어떤 계명을 지켜야 합니까?"

decisions.choice: which ones: which of the commands matter for this
decisions.reason: The word can mean "what sort". The man may be asking which commands count most, a question teachers debated (22:36).

decisions.choice: present tense of narration (L); past (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek present tense of narration.

decisions.choice: the man
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make clear who is speaking.

decisions.choice: historic present at Literal (le dice); pretérito at Balanced and Readable (preguntó)
decisions.reason: Matthew tells parts of this story in the present (English decision r-en-1). Literal keeps it, as the English Literal does; Balanced and Readable tell the story in the past, as Spanish narrative does. The same in verse 20.

decisions.choice: historic present kept at Literal (anamwambia); past at Balanced and Readable (aliuliza)
decisions.reason: Matthew tells parts of this story in the present (English decision r-en-1). Literal keeps it, as the English Literal does; Balanced and Readable use the narrative past, with -li- for the first verb and -ka- for those that follow. The same in verse 20.

decisions.choice: "nói" with no "đã" (L) for the historic present, also 19:20
decisions.reason: As elsewhere in Matthew, Literal keeps the present by leaving out "đã".

decisions.choice: [계명들입니까]; present "말한다" (L)
decisions.reason: The Greek has one word, "which ones"; Korean needs a noun and a verb, which Literal brackets. Literal keeps Matthew's present tense of narration.

source.text: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν· Τὸ Οὐ φονεύσεις, Οὐ μοιχεύσεις, Οὐ κλέψεις, Οὐ ψευδομαρτυρήσεις, Τίμα τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὴν μητέρα, καὶ Ἀγαπήσεις τὸν πλησίον σου ὡς σεαυτόν.

records.literal_gloss: The but Jesus said, The You will not murder, You will not commit adultery, You will not steal, You will not bear false witness, \v 19 Honor the father and the mother, and You will love the neighbor of you as yourself.

en.L: And Jesus said, "'You shall not murder; you shall not commit adultery; you shall not steal; you shall not bear false witness; \v 19 honor [your] father and mother'; and 'you shall love your neighbor as yourself.'"
en.B: Jesus said, "'Do not commit murder; do not commit adultery; do not steal; do not give false testimony; \v 19 honor your father and your mother'; and 'love your neighbor as yourself.'"
en.R: Jesus answered, "'Do not murder anyone. Do not commit adultery. Do not steal. Do not tell lies about other people. \v 19 Honor your father and mother.' And, 'Love other people as much as you love yourself.'"

es.L: Y Jesús dijo: «“No matarás; no cometerás adulterio; no robarás; no darás falso testimonio; \v 19 honra a [tu] padre y a [tu] madre”; y “amarás a tu prójimo como a ti mismo”».
es.B: Jesús le contestó: «“No cometas homicidio; no cometas adulterio; no robes; no des falso testimonio; \v 19 honra a tu padre y a tu madre”; y “ama a tu prójimo como a ti mismo”».
es.R: Jesús le respondió: «“No mates a nadie. No cometas adulterio. No robes. No digas mentiras contra otras personas. \v 19 Honra a tu padre y a tu madre”. Y también: “Ama a los demás tanto como te amas a ti mismo”».

fr.L: Et Jésus dit : « “Tu ne commettras pas de meurtre ; tu ne commettras pas d’adultère ; tu ne voleras pas ; tu ne porteras pas de faux témoignage ; \v 19 honore [ton] père et [ta] mère” ; et “tu aimeras ton prochain comme toi-même”. »
fr.B: Jésus répondit : « “Ne commets pas de meurtre ; ne commets pas d’adultère ; ne vole pas ; ne fais pas de faux témoignage ; \v 19 honore ton père et ta mère” ; et “aime ton prochain comme toi-même”. »
fr.R: Jésus a répondu : « “Ne tue personne. Ne commets pas d’adultère. Ne vole pas. Ne mens pas contre les autres. \v 19 Respecte ton père et ta mère.” Et aussi : “Aime les autres autant que tu t’aimes toi-même.” »

sw.L: Naye Yesu akasema, "'Hutaua; hutazini; hutaiba; hutatoa ushahidi wa uongo; \v 19 waheshimu baba na mama'; na 'utampenda jirani yako kama nafsi yako.'"
sw.B: Yesu alisema, "'Usiue; usizini; usiibe; usitoe ushahidi wa uongo; \v 19 waheshimu baba yako na mama yako'; na 'mpende jirani yako kama unavyojipenda mwenyewe.'"
sw.R: Yesu alijibu, "'Usimuue mtu. Usizini. Usiibe. Usiwasingizie watu wengine uongo. \v 19 Waheshimu baba yako na mama yako.' Tena, 'Wapende watu wengine kama unavyojipenda mwenyewe.'"

vi.L: Đức Giê-xu nói: "'Chớ giết người; chớ ngoại tình; chớ trộm cắp; chớ làm chứng dối; \v 19 hãy hiếu kính cha mẹ'; và 'hãy yêu thương người lân cận như chính mình.'"
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu đáp: "'Đừng giết người. Đừng ngoại tình. Đừng trộm cắp. Đừng làm chứng dối. \v 19 Hãy hiếu kính cha mẹ.' Và: 'Hãy yêu thương người lân cận như chính mình.'"
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu trả lời: "'Đừng giết người. Đừng ngoại tình. Đừng trộm cắp. Đừng nói dối để hại người khác. \v 19 Hãy tôn trọng cha mẹ mình.' Và: 'Hãy yêu thương người khác như yêu chính mình.'"

ko.L: 예수께서 말씀하셨다. "'살인하지 마라, 간음하지 마라, 도둑질하지 마라, 거짓 증언하지 마라, \v 19 아버지와 어머니를 공경하여라.' 그리고 '네 이웃을 너 자신처럼 사랑하여라.'"
ko.B: 예수께서 말씀하셨다. "'살인하지 마라. 간음하지 마라. 도둑질하지 마라. 거짓으로 증언하지 마라. \v 19 네 아버지와 어머니를 공경하여라.' 그리고 '네 이웃을 너 자신처럼 사랑하여라.'"
ko.R: 예수께서 대답하셨다. "'사람을 죽이지 마라. 간음하지 마라. 도둑질하지 마라. 다른 사람에 대해 거짓말하지 마라. \v 19 네 아버지와 어머니를 존경하여라.' 그리고 '다른 사람을 너 자신을 사랑하는 것만큼 사랑하여라.'"

pt.L: E Jesus disse: "'Não matarás; não adulterarás; não furtarás; não darás falso testemunho; \v 19 honra [teu] pai e mãe'; e 'amarás o teu próximo como a ti mesmo.'"
pt.B: Jesus disse: "'Não matarás; não cometerás adultério; não furtarás; não darás falso testemunho; \v 19 honra o teu pai e a tua mãe'; e 'amarás o teu próximo como a ti mesmo.'"
pt.R: Jesus respondeu: "'Não mates ninguém. Não cometas adultério. Não roubes. Não contes mentiras sobre os outros. \v 19 Honra o teu pai e a tua mãe.' E: 'Ama os outros como amas a ti mesmo.'"

decisions.choice: the commandments of the second table: Exodus 20:12-16; Deuteronomy 5:16-20
alternatives: a new list of Jesus's own
decisions.reason: Jesus names the sixth to ninth commandments and then the fifth. All of them concern how one treats other people.

decisions.choice: love your neighbor as yourself: Leviticus 19:18
decisions.reason: Only Matthew adds this command here. It sums up the others, and Jesus calls it the second great commandment (22:39).

decisions.choice: the: the article marks what follows as a quotation
alternatives: a word with its own meaning
decisions.reason: The Greek article introduces the list, like quotation marks.

decisions.choice: Do not commit murder; Do not commit adultery (B); Do not murder anyone (R)
decisions.reason: As at 5:21 and 5:27, Balanced and Readable give the commands in the plain form of a command.

decisions.choice: Do not tell lies about other people
decisions.reason: Readable says what false witness is.

decisions.choice: No matarás ... amarás (L); No cometas homicidio ... ama (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek gives the commandments as futures ("you will not murder"), and Spanish can keep that form at Literal, as the English Literal does; Balanced and Readable use the plain negative command, as the English does.

decisions.choice: tu ne commettras pas (L); ne commets pas (B); ne tue personne (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek future of the Law's commands; Balanced and Readable use the plain imperative, as the English and Mark 10:19 do. "Commettre un meurtre" says murder, which the commandment forbids, where "tuer" is wider.

decisions.choice: Hutaua; hutazini; hutaiba; hutatoa (L); Usiue; usizini (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek gives the commandments as futures ("you will not murder"). Swahili can say that with the negative future, which Literal keeps, as the English Literal does; Balanced and Readable use the usual negative command.

decisions.choice: "Chớ" (L); "Đừng" (B, R) for the commandments
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 5:21 and Mark 10:19.

decisions.choice: "người lân cận" (L, B); "người khác" (R) for neighbor
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 5:43.

decisions.choice: Modern spoken imperatives "-지 마라", "-여라"; "네 이웃을 너 자신처럼" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The commandments are worded as in the Korean Mark 10:19, and Leviticus 19:18 as in the Korean Luke 10:27; Jesus is speaking to the man, so the spoken imperative is used. Readable says who the neighbour is, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: the commandments in God's "tu" at every level
decisions.reason: Jesus quotes the Law, so the commandments keep the "tu" in which God speaks to a person, as in 5:21, 5:27 and 15:4 (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 4): future at Literal and Balanced ("Não matarás"), the plain imperative at Readable ("Não mates", "Honra").

source.text: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ νεανίσκος· Πάντα ταῦτα ἐφύλαξα· τί ἔτι ὑστερῶ;

records.literal_gloss: Says to him the young man, All these I have kept; what still do I lack?

en.L: The young man says to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "All these I have kept; what do I still lack?"
en.B: The young man said to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "I have obeyed every one of these. What am I still missing?"
en.R: The young man said, "I have obeyed all these commands. What else do I need to do?"

es.L: Le dice el joven: «Todo esto he guardado; ¿qué me falta todavía?».
es.B: El joven {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijo: «He obedecido cada uno de ellos. ¿Qué me falta todavía?».
es.R: El joven dijo: «He obedecido todos esos mandamientos. ¿Qué más tengo que hacer?».

fr.L: Le jeune homme {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dit : « Tout cela, je l’ai observé ; que me manque-t-il encore ? »
fr.B: Le jeune homme {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dit : « J’ai obéi à tous ces commandements. Que me manque-t-il encore ? »
fr.R: Le jeune homme a dit : « J’ai obéi à tous ces commandements. Qu’est-ce que je dois faire de plus ? »

sw.L: Kijana yule anamwambia, "Hayo yote nimeyatunza; ni nini bado ninachokosa?"
sw.B: Yule kijana alimwambia, "Nimezitii amri hizo zote. Ni nini bado kinachonipungukia?"
sw.R: Kijana yule alisema, "Nimezitii amri hizo zote. Nifanye nini kingine?"

vi.L: Người thanh niên nói với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Tất cả những điều này tôi đều đã giữ; tôi còn thiếu gì nữa?"
vi.B: Người thanh niên thưa với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Tôi đã vâng giữ tất cả những điều ấy. Tôi còn thiếu điều gì nữa?"
vi.R: Người thanh niên nói: "Tôi đã vâng giữ tất cả những điều răn ấy. Tôi còn phải làm gì nữa?"

ko.L: 그 젊은이가 그분께 말한다. "이 모든 것을 제가 지켰습니다. 아직 무엇이 부족합니까?"
ko.B: 그 젊은이가 예수께 말했다. "저는 그 모든 것을 다 지켰습니다. 아직 무엇이 더 부족합니까?"
ko.R: 그 젊은이가 말했다. "저는 그 계명들을 다 지켰습니다. 무엇을 더 해야 합니까?"

pt.L: O jovem {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} diz: "Tudo isso eu tenho guardado; o que ainda me falta?"
pt.B: O jovem {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} disse: "Tenho obedecido a cada um deles. O que ainda me falta?"
pt.R: O jovem disse: "Eu tenho obedecido a todos esses mandamentos. O que mais eu preciso fazer?"

decisions.choice: young man: a man in the prime of life
decisions.reason: The word was used of men from youth to about forty. Only Matthew calls him young.

decisions.choice: what do I still lack: he senses that something is missing
alternatives: a boast that nothing is lacking
decisions.reason: He has kept the commands, yet he asks what more is needed. Jesus answers that question in 19:21.

decisions.choice: I have kept, the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: I have kept from my youth, the reading of many later manuscripts
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts add "from my youth", as in Mark 10:20 and Luke 18:21. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: present tense of narration (L); past (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek present tense of narration.

decisions.choice: "người thanh niên" for the young man (19:20-22)
decisions.reason: The plain, respectful word for a young man.

decisions.choice: "젊은이" for neaniskos
decisions.reason: A man in the prime of life (meaning decision); "젊은이" is the plain word at every level.

source.text: ἔφη αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Εἰ θέλεις τέλειος εἶναι, ὕπαγε πώλησόν σου τὰ ὑπάρχοντα καὶ δὸς πτωχοῖς, καὶ ἕξεις θησαυρὸν ἐν οὐρανοῖς, καὶ δεῦρο ἀκολούθει μοι.

records.literal_gloss: Said to him the Jesus, If you want perfect to be, go sell of you the possessions and give to poor, and you will have treasure in heavens, and come follow me.

en.L: Jesus said to him, "If you want to be perfect, go, sell your possessions and give [them] to [the] poor, and you will have treasure in [the] heavens; and come, follow {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."
en.B: Jesus told him, "Do you want to be perfect? Then go, sell your property, and give the money to people who are poor, and treasure in heaven will be yours. After that, come and follow {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."
en.R: Jesus told him, "If you want to be perfect, go and sell everything you own. Give the money to poor people. Then you will have riches in heaven. After that, come and follow {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."

es.L: Jesús le dijo: «Si quieres ser perfecto, ve, vende tus posesiones y da[lo] a [los] pobres, y tendrás un tesoro en [los] cielos; y ven, sígueme».
es.B: Jesús le respondió: «¿Quieres ser perfecto? Entonces ve, vende tus bienes y da el dinero a los pobres, y tendrás un tesoro en el cielo. Después, ven y sígueme».
es.R: Jesús le dijo: «Si quieres ser perfecto, ve y vende todo lo que tienes. Da el dinero a los pobres. Así tendrás riquezas en el cielo. Después, ven y sígueme».

fr.L: Jésus lui déclara : « Si tu veux être parfait, va, vends tes biens et donne[-les] aux pauvres, et tu auras un trésor dans les cieux ; et viens, suis-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. »
fr.B: Jésus lui dit : « Veux-tu être parfait ? Alors va, vends ce que tu possèdes et donne l’argent aux pauvres, et tu auras un trésor dans le ciel. Ensuite, viens et suis-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. »
fr.R: Jésus lui a dit : « Si tu veux être parfait, va vendre tout ce que tu as. Donne l’argent aux pauvres. Alors tu auras des richesses dans le ciel. Ensuite, viens et suis-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. »

sw.L: Yesu alimwambia, "Ikiwa unataka kuwa mkamilifu, nenda, uza mali yako, uwape maskini, nawe utakuwa na hazina katika mbingu; kisha njoo, ufuatane {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}}."
sw.B: Yesu alimwambia, "Je, unataka kuwa mkamilifu? Basi nenda, uuze mali yako, uwape maskini fedha hizo, nawe utakuwa na hazina mbinguni. Baada ya hapo, njoo unifuate."
sw.R: Yesu alimwambia, "Ukitaka kuwa mkamilifu, nenda ukauze kila kitu ulicho nacho. Wape maskini fedha hizo. Hapo utakuwa na utajiri mbinguni. Baada ya hapo, njoo unifuate."

vi.L: Đức Giê-xu nói với người ấy: "Nếu anh muốn được trọn vẹn, hãy đi, bán những gì anh có và cho người nghèo, thì anh sẽ có kho báu trên các tầng trời; rồi hãy đến, theo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu bảo người ấy: "Anh muốn được trọn vẹn không? Vậy hãy đi bán tài sản của anh và đem tiền cho người nghèo, rồi anh sẽ có kho báu trên trời. Sau đó, hãy đến và theo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói với người ấy: "Nếu anh muốn được trọn vẹn, hãy đi bán hết những gì anh có. Hãy đem tiền cho người nghèo. Như vậy anh sẽ có của cải trên trời. Rồi hãy đến và đi theo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."

ko.L: 예수께서 그에게 말씀하셨다. "네가 온전해지고 싶으면, 가서 네 재산을 팔아 가난한 사람들에게 주어라. 그러면 네가 하늘들에서 보물을 가지게 될 것이다. 그리고 와서 나를 따라라."
ko.B: 예수께서 그에게 말씀하셨다. "네가 온전한 사람이 되고 싶으냐? 그러면 가서 네 재산을 팔아 그 돈을 가난한 사람들에게 주어라. 그러면 하늘에서 보물을 얻게 될 것이다. 그러고 나서 와서 나를 따라라."
ko.R: 예수께서 그에게 말씀하셨다. "네가 온전한 사람이 되고 싶으면, 가서 네가 가진 것을 다 팔아라. 그 돈을 가난한 사람들에게 주어라. 그러면 하늘에 재물을 쌓게 될 것이다. 그 뒤에 와서 나를 따라라."

pt.L: Jesus lhe disse: "Se você quer ser perfeito, vá, venda os seus bens e dê aos pobres, e você terá um tesouro nos céus; e venha, siga-{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."
pt.B: Jesus lhe disse: "Você quer ser perfeito? Então vá, venda o que você possui e dê o dinheiro aos pobres, e você terá um tesouro no céu. Depois venha e siga-{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."
pt.R: Jesus disse a ele: "Se você quer ser perfeito, vá e venda tudo o que você tem. Dê o dinheiro às pessoas pobres. Então você vai ter riquezas no céu. Depois disso, venha e siga-{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."

decisions.choice: perfect: complete, whole, lacking nothing
decisions.reason: This is the word of 5:48. It answers the man's question "what do I still lack?". Being whole means giving God undivided love, here shown by giving up wealth to follow Jesus. It does not set up a second, higher level of disciple.

decisions.choice: treasure in heaven: what God keeps for those who give and obey
alternatives: a reward earned by good deeds
decisions.reason: As in 6:19-21, what is given away for God is kept by God.

decisions.choice: come, follow me: the call to be a disciple
alternatives: a request to walk with Jesus that day
decisions.reason: These are the words Jesus used to call the fishermen and Matthew (4:19; 9:9). The way to life is to follow Jesus himself.

decisions.choice: riches
decisions.reason: Readable uses a common word.

decisions.choice: "trọn vẹn" for perfect
decisions.reason: The word of Matthew 5:48, whole and complete before God.

decisions.choice: "kho báu trên các tầng trời" (L); "kho báu trên trời" (B); "của cải trên trời" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 10:21 and Matthew 6:20.

decisions.choice: "온전하다" for teleios; "하늘들에서" (L), "하늘에서" (B), "하늘에" (R); "보물" (L, B), "재물" (R)
decisions.reason: "온전" is the word of the Korean Matthew 5:48 for the same adjective, complete and lacking nothing (meaning decision). Treasure in heaven is worded as in the Korean Mark 10:21.

source.text: ἀκούσας δὲ ὁ νεανίσκος τὸν λόγον ἀπῆλθεν λυπούμενος, ἦν γὰρ ἔχων κτήματα πολλά.

records.literal_gloss: Having heard but the young man the word he went away grieving, he was for having possessions many.

en.L: But when the young man heard this word, he went away grieving, for he had many possessions.
en.B: When the young man heard this, he went away in sorrow, because he owned a great deal of property.
en.R: When the young man heard this, he was very sad, and he went away. He was very rich.

es.L: Pero cuando el joven oyó la palabra, se marchó entristecido, porque era dueño de muchos bienes.
es.B: Cuando el joven oyó esto, se fue apenado, porque tenía muchísimas propiedades.
es.R: Cuando el joven oyó esto, se puso muy triste y se fue. Era muy rico.

fr.L: Mais le jeune homme, ayant entendu cette parole, s’en alla attristé, car il avait de nombreux biens.
fr.B: Quand le jeune homme entendit cela, il s’en alla tout triste, car il possédait de grandes propriétés.
fr.R: Quand le jeune homme a entendu cela, il est devenu très triste, et il est parti. Il était très riche.

sw.L: Lakini kijana yule aliposikia neno hilo, aliondoka akihuzunika, kwa sababu alikuwa mwenye milki nyingi.
sw.B: Yule kijana aliposikia hayo, aliondoka kwa huzuni, kwa sababu alikuwa mwenye mali nyingi sana.
sw.R: Kijana yule aliposikia hayo, alihuzunika sana, akaenda zake. Alikuwa tajiri sana.

vi.L: Nhưng nghe lời ấy, người thanh niên bỏ đi, buồn rầu, vì anh có nhiều của cải.
vi.B: Nghe vậy, người thanh niên buồn bã bỏ đi, vì anh có rất nhiều tài sản.
vi.R: Khi nghe vậy, người thanh niên rất buồn. Anh bỏ đi, vì anh rất giàu.

ko.L: 그러나 그 젊은이는 이 말씀을 듣고 근심하며 떠나갔다. 재산이 많은 사람이었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그 젊은이는 이 말씀을 듣고 슬퍼하며 떠나갔다. 그에게는 재산이 많았기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그 젊은이는 이 말씀을 듣고 몹시 슬퍼했다. 그리고 떠나갔다. 그는 큰 부자였다.

pt.L: Mas, ao ouvir essa palavra, o jovem foi embora triste, pois tinha muitos bens.
pt.B: Quando o jovem ouviu isso, foi embora entristecido, porque possuía muitos bens.
pt.R: Quando o jovem ouviu isso, ficou muito triste e foi embora. Ele era muito rico.

decisions.choice: grieving: sad and troubled
decisions.reason: The verb means to be sorrowful. He wants eternal life but will not let go of his wealth.

decisions.choice: possessions: property, likely land and goods
decisions.reason: The word is used of property, especially fields and estates (as in Acts 5:1).

decisions.choice: He was very rich
decisions.reason: Readable states the point simply.

source.text: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ· Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι πλούσιος δυσκόλως εἰσελεύσεται εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν·

records.literal_gloss: The and Jesus said to the disciples of him, Truly I say to you that a rich [man] with difficulty will enter into the kingdom of the heavens;

en.L: And Jesus said to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples, "Truly I tell you that a rich [{{gender:person|man}}] will enter the kingdom of the heavens with difficulty;
en.B: Then Jesus said to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples, "Truly I tell you, a rich person will find it hard to get into the kingdom of heaven.
en.R: Jesus said to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} followers, "I tell you the truth, it is hard for a rich person to enter the kingdom of heaven.

es.L: Y Jesús dijo a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos: «En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que con dificultad entrará {{gender:alguien rico|un rico}} en el reino de los cielos;
es.B: Entonces Jesús dijo a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos: «En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que a una persona rica le costará entrar en el reino de los cielos.
es.R: Jesús les dijo a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos: «{{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo la verdad: es difícil que una persona rica entre en el reino de los cielos.

fr.L: Et Jésus dit à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples : « En vérité, je vous dis qu’un riche entrera difficilement dans le royaume des cieux ;
fr.B: Alors Jésus dit à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples : « En vérité, je vous le dis, un riche aura bien du mal à entrer dans le royaume des cieux.
fr.R: Jésus a dit à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples : « Je vous le dis, c’est la vérité : c’est difficile pour une personne riche d’entrer dans le royaume des cieux.

sw.L: Naye Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, "Kweli nawaambia kwamba tajiri ataingia kwa shida katika ufalme wa mbinguni;
sw.B: Kisha Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, "Kweli nawaambia, itakuwa vigumu kwa tajiri kuingia katika ufalme wa mbinguni.
sw.R: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, "Nawaambia ukweli, ni vigumu kwa mtu tajiri kuingia katika ufalme wa mbinguni.

vi.L: Và Đức Giê-xu nói với các môn đồ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con rằng người giàu có sẽ khó vào vương quốc thiên đàng;
vi.B: Bấy giờ Đức Giê-xu nói với các môn đồ: "Thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con, người giàu khó mà vào được vương quốc thiên đàng.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói với các môn đồ: "Ta nói thật với các con, người giàu vào vương quốc thiên đàng thật là khó.

ko.L: 그러자 예수께서 자기 제자들에게 말씀하셨다. "진실로 너희에게 말한다. 부자는 어렵게 천국에 들어갈 것이다.
ko.B: 그러자 예수께서 제자들에게 말씀하셨다. "진실로 너희에게 말한다. 부자가 천국에 들어가기는 어렵다.
ko.R: 예수께서 제자들에게 말씀하셨다. "내가 분명히 말한다. 부자가 천국에 들어가기는 정말 어렵다.

pt.L: E Jesus disse aos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} discípulos: "Em verdade eu lhes digo que um rico dificilmente entrará no Reino dos céus;
pt.B: Então Jesus disse aos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} discípulos: "Em verdade eu lhes digo: para quem é rico, vai ser difícil entrar no Reino dos céus.
pt.R: Jesus disse aos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} seguidores: "Eu garanto a vocês: é difícil uma pessoa rica entrar no Reino dos céus.

decisions.choice: with difficulty: hardly, only with great trouble
decisions.reason: The word means hard to do. The next saying (19:24) shows how hard.

decisions.choice: a rich person: wealth holds people back from following Jesus
decisions.reason: As the young man just showed, wealth can hold a heart so firmly that a person will not give it up for God (6:24).

decisions.choice: Truly I tell you (L, B); I tell you the truth (R)
decisions.reason: As in 5:18, the solemn opening is given in the same words at each level.

decisions.choice: a rich [{{gender:person|man}}]
decisions.reason: The saying is about any rich person.

decisions.choice: En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo (L, B); {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo la verdad (R); el reino de los cielos
decisions.reason: The New Testament rendering of the single amen, as at 16:28, and Matthew's "el reino de los cielos", which Spanish keeps in the plural at every level. Jesus speaks to the disciples together, so the plural "you" takes the ustedes / vosotros setting through verse 28.

decisions.choice: {{gender:alguien rico|un rico}}
decisions.reason: As the English Literal "a rich [person|man]": the Greek word is an adjective used as a noun, which Spanish can say as "un rico" or as "alguien rico", man or woman. The same in verse 24. Balanced and Readable say "una persona rica", which needs no span.

decisions.choice: En vérité, je vous le dis (L, B); Je vous le dis, c’est la vérité (R), here and in 19:28; le royaume des cieux at every level; les disciples at Readable too
decisions.reason: The forms settled for the New Testament and used in Mark and Luke. French "disciple" is an everyday word, so Readable keeps it where the English says "followers" (19:25).

decisions.choice: "un riche" with no gender setting, here and in 19:24
decisions.reason: As Mark 10:25: the Greek has only the adjective used as a noun, and French "un riche" already means any rich person, so French has no noun to choose where the English Literal supplies [{{gender:person|man}}].

decisions.choice: Kweli nawaambia (L, B); Nawaambia ukweli (R); tajiri, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The New Testament rendering of the single amen, as at 16:28. "Tajiri" means a rich person, man or woman, so the English Literal span "person|man" has no Swahili counterpart, here or in verse 24.

decisions.choice: "Thật vậy, Ta nói với các con" (L, B); "Ta nói thật với các con" (R); "người giàu" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The settled formula for Jesus's "amen"; Vietnamese "người giàu" is already inclusive.

decisions.choice: "진실로 너희에게 말한다" (L, B), "내가 분명히 말한다" (R), through 19:28; "부자" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The settled Korean amen formula. "부자" already means any rich person, man or woman (style guide, section 7), as in the Korean Mark 10:25.

decisions.choice: Em verdade eu lhes digo (L, B); Eu garanto a vocês (R)
decisions.reason: The solemn opening in the words set for the New Testament (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 6), the same at 19:28.

decisions.choice: um rico, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The Greek has the adjective alone. Portuguese can use it alone too, "um rico", which means any rich person, so it needs no supplied noun and no setting; Balanced and Readable say "quem é rico", "uma pessoa rica". The same in 19:24.

source.text: πάλιν δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν, εὐκοπώτερόν ἐστιν κάμηλον διὰ τρυπήματος ῥαφίδος εἰσελθεῖν ἢ πλούσιον εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Again and I say to you, easier it is a camel through eye of a needle to go than a rich [man] into the kingdom of the God.

en.L: And again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than [for] a rich [{{gender:person|man}}] [to enter] into the kingdom of God."
en.B: I say it again: a camel could pass through the eye of a needle more easily than a rich person could enter the kingdom of God."
en.R: I will say it again. It would be easier for a camel to go through the hole in a sewing needle than for a rich person to enter God's kingdom."

es.L: Y de nuevo {{plural_you:les|os}} digo: es más fácil que un camello entre por el agujero de una aguja que [entre] {{gender:alguien rico|un rico}} en el reino de Dios».
es.B: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} lo repito: a un camello le resultaría más fácil pasar por el ojo de una aguja que a una persona rica entrar en el reino de Dios».
es.R: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} lo vuelvo a decir: sería más fácil que un camello pasara por el agujerito de una aguja de coser que una persona rica entrara en el reino de Dios».

fr.L: Et je vous le dis encore, il est plus facile à un chameau de passer par le trou d’une aiguille qu’à un riche [d’entrer] dans le royaume de Dieu. »
fr.B: Je vous le dis encore : un chameau passerait plus facilement par le trou d’une aiguille qu’un riche n’entrerait dans le royaume de Dieu. »
fr.R: Je vous le répète : il serait plus facile pour un chameau de passer par le trou d’une aiguille à coudre que pour une personne riche d’entrer dans le royaume de Dieu. »

sw.L: Tena nawaambia, ni rahisi kwa ngamia kuingia kupitia tundu la sindano kuliko kwa tajiri [kuingia] katika ufalme wa Mungu."
sw.B: Nasema tena: ngamia angeweza kupita kwenye tundu la sindano kwa urahisi zaidi kuliko tajiri angeweza kuingia katika ufalme wa Mungu."
sw.R: Nasema tena, ingekuwa rahisi zaidi ngamia kupita kwenye kitundu cha sindano ya kushonea kuliko mtu tajiri kuingia katika ufalme wa Mungu."

vi.L: Ta lại nói với các con, con lạc đà đi qua lỗ kim còn dễ hơn người giàu vào vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời."
vi.B: Ta nói thêm với các con: một con lạc đà chui qua lỗ kim còn dễ hơn một người giàu vào được vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời."
vi.R: Ta nói lại lần nữa: một con lạc đà chui qua lỗ của cây kim khâu còn dễ hơn một người giàu vào vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời."

ko.L: 다시 너희에게 말한다. 낙타가 바늘귀로 들어가는 것이 부자가 하나님의 나라에 [들어가는 것]보다 더 쉽다."
ko.B: 내가 다시 말한다. 부자가 하나님의 나라에 들어가는 것보다 낙타가 바늘귀로 지나가는 것이 더 쉽다."
ko.R: 내가 다시 말한다. 부자가 하나님의 나라에 들어가는 것보다 낙타가 바느질하는 바늘의 구멍으로 빠져나가는 것이 더 쉬울 것이다."

pt.L: E outra vez eu lhes digo: é mais fácil um camelo passar pelo buraco de uma agulha do que um rico [entrar] no Reino de Deus."
pt.B: Repito: um camelo passaria pelo buraco de uma agulha com mais facilidade do que um rico entraria no Reino de Deus."
pt.R: Vou dizer de novo: seria mais fácil um camelo passar pelo buraco de uma agulha de costura do que uma pessoa rica entrar no Reino de Deus."

decisions.choice: a camel through the eye of a needle: something impossible
decisions.reason: The camel was the largest animal in the land and the eye of a needle the smallest opening. The picture is meant to be absurd, like the camel swallowed in 23:24. The disciples' question and Jesus's answer (19:25-26) show that it is impossible for people.

decisions.choice: a real camel and a real sewing needle
alternatives: a narrow gate in Jerusalem called the Needle's Eye
a rope, by a change of one letter
decisions.reason: The story of a small gate called the Needle's Eye is told only centuries later, and there is no evidence for such a gate in Jesus's day. The reading "rope" is found only in a few late manuscripts. Both try to soften a saying meant to shock.

decisions.choice: the kingdom of God: the same as the kingdom of heaven in 19:23
decisions.reason: Matthew usually says "kingdom of heaven" but sometimes "kingdom of God" (12:28; 21:31, 43). The two sayings stand side by side here.

decisions.choice: a rich [{{gender:person|man}}]
decisions.reason: As in 19:23.

decisions.choice: the hole in a sewing needle
decisions.reason: Readable says what the eye of a needle is.

decisions.choice: el agujero de una aguja (L); el ojo de una aguja (B); el agujerito de una aguja de coser (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek word is simply a hole, the eye of a real sewing needle (meaning decision m2); Literal says "agujero", Balanced uses the everyday "ojo", and Readable says what kind of needle, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời" here, not "vương quốc thiên đàng"
decisions.reason: The Greek says "the kingdom of God" in this verse; as in 12:28 the wording follows it.

decisions.choice: "하나님의 나라" here, "천국" in 19:23
decisions.reason: Matthew changes the wording here (meaning decision: the same kingdom); Korean keeps his change, as the English does. The camel and the needle are real (footnoted meaning decision); Readable says it is a sewing needle.

decisions.choice: [들어가는 것]
decisions.reason: The Greek leaves "to enter" to be understood with the rich person; Literal brackets it.

source.text: ἀκούσαντες δὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἐξεπλήσσοντο σφόδρα λέγοντες· Τίς ἄρα δύναται σωθῆναι;

records.literal_gloss: Having heard and the disciples were astonished greatly saying, Who then is able to be saved?

en.L: And when the disciples heard [this], they were greatly astonished, saying, "Who then can be saved?"
en.B: The disciples were utterly amazed at this. "Then who can be saved?" they asked.
en.R: When Jesus's followers heard this, they were very surprised. They asked, "Then who can be saved?"

es.L: Y al oír[lo], los discípulos se asombraban muchísimo, diciendo: «¿Quién, entonces, puede ser salvo?».
es.B: Los discípulos quedaron atónitos al oír esto. «Entonces, ¿quién puede salvarse?», preguntaban.
es.R: Cuando los discípulos de Jesús oyeron esto, se quedaron muy sorprendidos. Preguntaron: «Entonces, ¿quién puede ser salvo?».

fr.L: Et les disciples, ayant entendu [cela], étaient extrêmement frappés, disant : « Qui donc peut être sauvé ? »
fr.B: En entendant cela, les disciples furent complètement stupéfaits. « Qui donc peut être sauvé ? » demandaient-ils.
fr.R: Quand les disciples ont entendu cela, ils ont été très surpris. Ils ont demandé : « Alors, qui peut être sauvé ? »

sw.L: Na wanafunzi waliposikia [hayo], walikuwa wakistaajabu sana, wakisema, "Basi, nani anaweza kuokolewa?"
sw.B: Wanafunzi walipigwa na mshangao mkubwa waliposikia hayo. Wakauliza, "Basi ni nani atakayeweza kuokolewa?"
sw.R: Wanafunzi wa Yesu waliposikia hayo, walishangaa sana. Wakauliza, "Basi ni nani anayeweza kuokolewa?"

vi.L: Nghe [vậy], các môn đồ hết sức kinh ngạc và nói: "Vậy thì ai có thể được cứu?"
vi.B: Nghe vậy, các môn đồ vô cùng kinh ngạc và hỏi: "Thế thì ai có thể được cứu?"
vi.R: Khi nghe điều ấy, các môn đồ rất ngạc nhiên. Họ hỏi: "Thế thì ai có thể được cứu?"

ko.L: 제자들이 [이 말씀을] 듣고 몹시 놀라서 말했다. "그러면 누가 구원받을 수 있습니까?"
ko.B: 제자들은 이 말씀을 듣고 몹시 놀라서 물었다. "그렇다면 누가 구원받을 수 있습니까?"
ko.R: 제자들은 이 말씀을 듣고 매우 놀랐다. 그래서 여쭈었다. "그러면 누가 구원받을 수 있습니까?"

pt.L: E, ao ouvirem [isso], os discípulos ficaram muito espantados, dizendo: "Quem, então, pode ser salvo?"
pt.B: Os discípulos ficaram muito admirados com isso. "Então quem pode ser salvo?", perguntaram.
pt.R: Quando os seguidores de Jesus ouviram isso, ficaram muito surpresos. Eles perguntaram: "Então quem pode ser salvo?"

decisions.choice: greatly astonished: wealth was widely seen as a sign of God's blessing
alternatives: surprised that rich people were mentioned
decisions.reason: The law promised plenty to those who obey (Deuteronomy 28:1-14). If even the rich, who seemed blessed, cannot enter, the disciples ask who can.

decisions.choice: be saved: be rescued for the life of the age to come
alternatives: be kept safe in this life
decisions.reason: In this passage being saved means having eternal life (19:16) and entering the kingdom (19:24).

decisions.choice: were astonished: the imperfect tense, they kept on being amazed
decisions.reason: The tense pictures continuing amazement.

decisions.choice: The disciples ask Jesus in 합쇼체; "구원받다"
alternatives: 해라체 among themselves, as the Korean Mark 10:26
decisions.reason: Matthew does not say they spoke to one another, and Jesus answers them, so Korean has them ask him. "구원받다" as in the Korean Mark.

decisions.choice: [이 말씀을]
decisions.reason: Korean "듣다" needs an object here; Literal brackets it.

source.text: ἐμβλέψας δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Παρὰ ἀνθρώποις τοῦτο ἀδύνατόν ἐστιν, παρὰ δὲ θεῷ πάντα δυνατά.

records.literal_gloss: Having looked at [them] and the Jesus said to them, With men this impossible is, with but God all things possible.

en.L: And Jesus looked at [them] and said to them, "With {{gender:human beings|men}} this is impossible, but with God all things [are] possible."
en.B: Jesus looked straight at them and said, "For human beings this cannot be done, but for God everything is possible."
en.R: Jesus looked at them and said, "People cannot save themselves. But God can do anything."

es.L: Y Jesús, fijando en [ellos] la mirada, les dijo: «Para {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}} esto es imposible, pero para Dios todas las cosas [son] posibles».
es.B: Jesús los miró fijamente y les dijo: «Para los seres humanos esto no se puede hacer, pero para Dios todo es posible».
es.R: Jesús los miró y les dijo: «Las personas no pueden salvarse a sí mismas. Pero Dios puede hacerlo todo».

fr.L: Et Jésus, [les] ayant regardés, leur dit : « Pour les {{gender:humains|hommes}}, cela est impossible, mais pour Dieu tout [est] possible. »
fr.B: Jésus les regarda droit dans les yeux et leur dit : « Pour les êtres humains, c’est impossible, mais pour Dieu, tout est possible. »
fr.R: Jésus les a regardés et a dit : « Les gens ne peuvent pas se sauver eux-mêmes. Mais Dieu peut tout faire. »

sw.L: Naye Yesu, akiwatazama, aliwaambia, "Kwa wanadamu jambo hili haliwezekani, lakini kwa Mungu mambo yote [yanawezekana]."
sw.B: Yesu aliwaangalia sawasawa, akasema, "Kwa binadamu jambo hili haliwezekani, lakini kwa Mungu kila kitu kinawezekana."
sw.R: Yesu aliwatazama, akasema, "Watu hawawezi kujiokoa wenyewe. Lakini Mungu anaweza kufanya lolote."

vi.L: Đức Giê-xu nhìn họ và nói: "Đối với loài người, điều này là không thể, nhưng đối với Đức Chúa Trời, mọi sự đều có thể."
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu nhìn thẳng vào họ và nói: "Đối với loài người thì điều này không thể làm được, nhưng đối với Đức Chúa Trời thì mọi sự đều có thể."
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nhìn họ và nói: "Con người không thể tự cứu mình. Nhưng Đức Chúa Trời làm được mọi việc."

ko.L: 예수께서 그들을 바라보시며 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "사람에게는 이것이 불가능하지만, 하나님께는 모든 것이 가능하다."
ko.B: 예수께서 그들을 똑바로 바라보시며 말씀하셨다. "사람은 이 일을 할 수 없지만, 하나님께서는 무엇이든 하실 수 있다."
ko.R: 예수께서 그들을 바라보시며 말씀하셨다. "사람은 스스로 구원받을 수 없다. 그러나 하나님께서는 무엇이든지 하실 수 있다."

pt.L: E Jesus, olhando [para eles], lhes disse: "Para {{gender:os seres humanos|os homens}} isso é impossível, mas para Deus todas as coisas [são] possíveis."
pt.B: Jesus olhou bem para eles e disse: "Para os seres humanos isso não é possível, mas para Deus tudo é possível."
pt.R: Jesus olhou para eles e disse: "As pessoas não conseguem salvar a si mesmas. Mas Deus pode fazer qualquer coisa."

decisions.choice: this: being saved
alternatives: a camel going through a needle
decisions.reason: "This" refers to the disciples' question. No one, rich or poor, can bring about salvation by human power.

decisions.choice: with God all things are possible: the words to Abraham and Sarah
decisions.reason: God asked, "Is anything too hard for the LORD?" when he promised Sarah a son (Genesis 18:14). Job confesses that God can do all things (Job 42:2).

decisions.choice: looked at them: looked intently
decisions.reason: The verb is used of a steady, searching look.

decisions.choice: {{gender:human beings|men}}
decisions.reason: As in 9:8, the word means human beings.

decisions.choice: People cannot save themselves
decisions.reason: Readable says what is impossible.

decisions.choice: {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}}
decisions.reason: As the English Literal {{gender:human beings|men}}: the Greek word means human beings, and Spanish can say it either way. Balanced says "los seres humanos" and Readable "las personas", which need no span.

decisions.choice: "loài người" (L, B), with no gender span
decisions.reason: As in Mark 10:27; the word is already inclusive.

decisions.choice: "사람" with no gender span
decisions.reason: "사람" already includes men and women (style guide, section 7), as in the Korean Mark 10:27.

source.text: Τότε ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Πέτρος εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ἰδοὺ ἡμεῖς ἀφήκαμεν πάντα καὶ ἠκολουθήσαμέν σοι· τί ἄρα ἔσται ἡμῖν;

records.literal_gloss: Then answering the Peter said to him, Behold we left all things and followed you; what then will be to us?

en.L: Then Peter answered and said to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Look, we have left everything and followed {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; what then will there be for us?"
en.B: Then Peter spoke up. "We have left everything behind and followed {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}," he said to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. "So what will we receive?"
en.R: Then Peter said to Jesus, "We left everything we had to follow {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. So what will we get?"

es.L: Entonces respondiendo Pedro, {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijo: «Mira, nosotros lo dejamos todo y {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} seguimos; ¿qué habrá, pues, para nosotros?».
es.B: Entonces Pedro tomó la palabra: «Nosotros lo hemos dejado todo y {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} hemos seguido», {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijo. «¿Qué vamos a recibir?».
es.R: Entonces Pedro le dijo a Jesús: «Nosotros dejamos todo lo que teníamos para seguirte. ¿Qué vamos a recibir?».

fr.L: Alors Pierre, répondant, {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dit : « Voici, nous avons tout laissé et nous {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}avons suivi ; qu’y aura-t-il donc pour nous ? »
fr.B: Pierre prit alors la parole. « Nous avons tout quitté pour {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} suivre, {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dit-il. Que recevrons-nous donc ? »
fr.R: Alors Pierre a dit à Jésus : « Nous avons laissé tout ce que nous avions pour {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} suivre. Alors, qu’est-ce que nous allons recevoir ? »

sw.L: Ndipo Petro alipojibu, akamwambia, "Angalia, sisi tumeviacha vitu vyote na kukufuata {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}; basi, itakuwa nini kwetu?"
sw.B: Kisha Petro alisema, "Sisi tumeacha kila kitu nyuma, tukakufuata {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}. Basi tutapokea nini?"
sw.R: Kisha Petro alimwambia Yesu, "Tuliacha kila kitu tulichokuwa nacho ili tukufuate. Basi tutapata nini?"

vi.L: Bấy giờ Phi-e-rơ đáp lời, nói với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Này, chúng con đã bỏ mọi sự và đã theo Chúa; vậy chúng con sẽ được gì?"
vi.B: Bấy giờ Phi-e-rơ lên tiếng thưa: "Chúng con đã bỏ hết mọi sự để theo Chúa. Vậy chúng con sẽ được gì?"
vi.R: Rồi Phi-e-rơ thưa với Đức Giê-xu: "Chúng con đã bỏ hết mọi thứ mình có để đi theo Chúa. Vậy chúng con sẽ được gì?"

ko.L: 그때에 베드로가 대답하여 그분께 말했다. "보십시오, 저희는 모든 것을 버리고 주님을 따랐습니다. 그러면 저희에게는 무엇이 있겠습니까?"
ko.B: 그때 베드로가 나서서 예수께 말했다. "저희는 모든 것을 버리고 주님을 따랐습니다. 그러면 저희는 무엇을 받게 됩니까?"
ko.R: 그때 베드로가 예수께 말했다. "저희는 가진 것을 다 버리고 주님을 따라왔습니다. 그러면 저희는 무엇을 얻게 됩니까?"

pt.L: Então Pedro, respondendo, {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} disse: "Eis que nós deixamos tudo e {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} seguimos; o que, então, haverá para nós?"
pt.B: Então Pedro tomou a palavra. "Nós deixamos tudo para trás e {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} seguimos", ele {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} disse. "O que vamos receber, então?"
pt.R: Então Pedro disse a Jesus: "Nós deixamos tudo o que tínhamos para {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} seguir. Então, o que vamos ganhar?"

decisions.choice: we: emphatic, set against the young man who would not leave his wealth
decisions.reason: Peter speaks for the Twelve. They have done what the young man refused to do (4:20, 22; 9:9).

decisions.choice: what will there be for us: what reward will we have
decisions.reason: Peter asks about the treasure in heaven Jesus promised (19:21).

decisions.choice: look (L); not rendered (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:20, Literal uses "look" and Balanced and Readable carry the word's force in the flow of the sentence.

decisions.choice: "Chúa" for "you" and "chúng con" for "we" in Peter's words, with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: As settled for Matthew: Peter speaks to Jesus as Lord (18:21, 14:28), and none of these words of address take a setting span.

decisions.choice: "보십시오" (L), not rendered (B, R); "주님" for "you"; "저희"
decisions.reason: Peter's "look" is addressed to Jesus, so it takes the polite imperative; Korean says "you" to a superior with a title, and in the Korean Matthew the disciples address Jesus as "주님" (16:22; 26:33, 26:35), where Mark keeps "선생님". The emphatic "we" (meaning decision) is the humble "저희".

source.text: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ὑμεῖς οἱ ἀκολουθήσαντές μοι ἐν τῇ παλιγγενεσίᾳ, ὅταν καθίσῃ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐπὶ θρόνου δόξης αὐτοῦ, καθήσεσθε καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐπὶ δώδεκα θρόνους κρίνοντες τὰς δώδεκα φυλὰς τοῦ Ἰσραήλ.

records.literal_gloss: The and Jesus said to them, Truly I say to you that you the [ones] having followed me, in the regeneration, when sits the Son of the Man on throne of glory of him, will sit also you on twelve thrones judging the twelve tribes of the Israel.

en.L: And Jesus said to them, "Truly I tell you that you who have followed {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, in the renewal [of all things], when the Son of Man sits on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} throne of glory, you also will sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
en.B: Jesus said to them, "Truly I tell you, when all things are made new and the Son of Man takes {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} seat on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glorious throne, you who have followed {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} will also take your seats on twelve thrones and judge the twelve tribes of Israel.
en.R: Jesus said to them, "I tell you the truth, God will make the whole world new. Then the Son of Man will sit on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glorious throne as king. And you who have followed {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} will also sit on twelve thrones. You will judge the twelve tribes of Israel.

es.L: Y Jesús les dijo: «En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:han seguido|habéis seguido}}, en la renovación [de todas las cosas], cuando el Hijo del Hombre se siente sobre {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} trono de gloria, también {{plural_you:ustedes se sentarán|vosotros os sentaréis}} sobre doce tronos, juzgando a las doce tribus de Israel.
es.B: Jesús les dijo: «En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que, cuando todo sea hecho nuevo y el Hijo del Hombre ocupe {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} trono glorioso, {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:han seguido|habéis seguido}}, también {{plural_you:ocuparán|ocuparéis}} doce tronos y {{plural_you:juzgarán|juzgaréis}} a las doce tribus de Israel.
es.R: Jesús les dijo: «{{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo la verdad: Dios hará nuevo el mundo entero. Entonces el Hijo del Hombre se sentará como rey en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} trono glorioso. Y {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:han seguido|habéis seguido}}, también {{plural_you:se sentarán|os sentaréis}} en doce tronos. {{plural_you:Juzgarán|Juzgaréis}} a las doce tribus de Israel.

fr.L: Et Jésus leur dit : « En vérité, je vous dis que vous qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez suivi, lors du renouvellement [de toutes choses], quand le Fils de l’homme siégera sur {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} trône de gloire, vous aussi, vous siégerez sur douze trônes, jugeant les douze tribus d’Israël.
fr.B: Jésus leur dit : « En vérité, je vous le dis, quand toutes choses seront renouvelées et que le Fils de l’homme siégera sur {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} trône glorieux, vous qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez suivi, vous siégerez vous aussi sur douze trônes et vous jugerez les douze tribus d’Israël.
fr.R: Jésus leur a dit : « Je vous le dis, c’est la vérité : Dieu va rendre le monde entier nouveau. Alors le Fils de l’homme s’assiéra comme roi sur {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} trône glorieux. Et vous qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez suivi, vous serez assis, vous aussi, sur douze trônes. Vous jugerez les douze tribus d’Israël.

sw.L: Naye Yesu akawaambia, "Kweli nawaambia kwamba ninyi mlionifuata, katika kufanywa upya [kwa vitu vyote], Mwana wa Adamu atakapoketi juu ya kiti cha enzi cha utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, ninyi pia mtaketi juu ya viti vya enzi kumi na viwili, mkihukumu makabila kumi na mawili ya Israeli.
sw.B: Yesu aliwaambia, "Kweli nawaambia, wakati vitu vyote vitakapofanywa upya, na Mwana wa Adamu atakapoketi kwenye kiti {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} cha enzi chenye utukufu, ninyi mlionifuata mtaketi pia kwenye viti vya enzi kumi na viwili na kuyahukumu makabila kumi na mawili ya Israeli.
sw.R: Yesu aliwaambia, "Nawaambia ukweli, Mungu atafanya ulimwengu wote kuwa mpya. Hapo Mwana wa Adamu ataketi kama mfalme kwenye kiti {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} cha enzi chenye utukufu. Nanyi mlionifuata mtaketi pia kwenye viti vya enzi kumi na viwili. Mtayahukumu makabila kumi na mawili ya Israeli.

vi.L: Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con rằng các con là những người đã theo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, trong sự đổi mới [muôn vật], khi Con Người ngồi trên ngai vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, thì chính các con cũng sẽ ngồi trên mười hai ngai, xét xử mười hai chi phái Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con, khi muôn vật được đổi mới và Con Người ngồi trên ngai vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, thì các con, là những người đã theo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, cũng sẽ ngồi trên mười hai ngai để xét xử mười hai chi phái Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Ta nói thật với các con, Đức Chúa Trời sẽ làm mới lại cả thế giới. Khi ấy Con Người sẽ ngồi trên ngai vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để cai trị như một vị vua. Và các con, là những người đã theo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, cũng sẽ ngồi trên mười hai ngai. Các con sẽ xét xử mười hai chi phái Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "진실로 너희에게 말한다. 나를 따른 너희는, [만물이] 새롭게 될 때에 인자가 자기 영광의 보좌에 앉을 때, 너희도 열두 보좌에 앉아 이스라엘의 열두 지파를 심판할 것이다.
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "진실로 너희에게 말한다. 모든 것이 새롭게 되어 인자가 영광스러운 보좌에 앉을 때, 나를 따른 너희도 열두 보좌에 앉아 이스라엘의 열두 지파를 심판할 것이다.
ko.R: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "내가 분명히 말한다. 하나님께서 온 세상을 새롭게 하실 것이다. 그때 인자, 곧 사람의 아들이 왕으로서 영광스러운 보좌에 앉을 것이다. 그리고 나를 따른 너희도 열두 보좌에 앉을 것이다. 너희는 이스라엘의 열두 지파를 다스리고 심판할 것이다.

pt.L: E Jesus lhes disse: "Em verdade eu lhes digo que vocês, que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} seguiram, na renovação [de todas as coisas], quando o Filho do Homem se sentar no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} trono de glória, também vocês se sentarão em doze tronos, julgando as doze tribos de Israel.
pt.B: Jesus lhes disse: "Em verdade eu lhes digo: quando todas as coisas forem renovadas e o Filho do Homem se sentar no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} trono glorioso, vocês que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} seguiram também vão se sentar em doze tronos para julgar as doze tribos de Israel.
pt.R: Jesus disse a eles: "Eu garanto a vocês: Deus vai fazer novo o mundo inteiro. Então o Filho do Homem vai se sentar no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} trono glorioso como rei. E vocês, que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} seguiram, também vão se sentar em doze tronos. Vocês vão julgar as doze tribos de Israel.

decisions.choice: the renewal: the new birth of the world in the age to come
alternatives: the new birth of a believer
decisions.reason: The word means a rebirth. Here it is the making new of all creation that the prophets promised (Isaiah 65:17; 66:22), when the Son of Man reigns.

decisions.choice: in the renewal goes with "you will sit"
alternatives: it goes with "you who have followed me"
decisions.reason: The phrase stands between the two. It most naturally says when the disciples will sit on thrones, not when they followed Jesus.

decisions.choice: the Son of Man on his throne of glory: Daniel 7:9-14
alternatives: a throne in the present age
decisions.reason: In Daniel thrones are set up and one like a son of man receives an everlasting kingdom. Matthew speaks again of the Son of Man's throne of glory in 25:31.

decisions.choice: judging: ruling over, and passing judgment on
decisions.reason: In the Scriptures to judge Israel often means to govern it, as the judges did. It may also include judgment at the end. The twelve disciples answer to the twelve tribes.

decisions.choice: Truly I tell you (L, B); I tell you the truth (R)
decisions.reason: As in 5:18, the solemn opening is given in the same words at each level.

decisions.choice: God will make the whole world new
decisions.reason: Readable says what the renewal is.

decisions.choice: glorious throne
decisions.reason: "Glorious" keeps the key term in its adjective form.

decisions.choice: la renovación [de todas las cosas] (L); cuando todo sea hecho nuevo (B)
decisions.reason: The word names the new birth of the world in the age to come (meaning decision m1). "Regeneración" now suggests a body healing or a person's new birth, so Literal says "renovación", with the bracket the English Literal has.

decisions.choice: el Hijo del Hombre, with capitals and no gender setting
decisions.reason: The title used through Matthew, as in John: Jesus speaks of himself, so it is never under the gender setting.

decisions.choice: Mwana wa Adamu; kiti cha enzi, viti vya enzi
decisions.reason: The terms used across the New Testament drafts: "Mwana wa Adamu" is the settled Swahili title, as in John, never under the gender setting; "kiti cha enzi" is a royal throne, where "kiti" alone is any chair.

decisions.choice: "sự đổi mới [muôn vật]" (L); "khi muôn vật được đổi mới" (B); "Đức Chúa Trời sẽ làm mới lại cả thế giới" (R)
decisions.reason: The renewal of all things at the end; "tái sinh" would suggest a person's new birth.

decisions.choice: "{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}" for the Son of Man's "his"
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 13:41: Jesus speaks of the Son of Man in the third person, and the pronoun takes the setting.

decisions.choice: "[만물이] 새롭게 될 때" (L); "모든 것이 새롭게 되어" (B); "하나님께서 온 세상을 새롭게 하실 것이다" (R); "인자", with "곧 사람의 아들" once at Readable
decisions.reason: The renewal is the new birth of the world in the age to come (meaning decision); Literal brackets the subject Korean needs. "인자" is a title at every level (style guide, section 6); Readable explains it once in this passage, as the Korean Matthew does elsewhere.

decisions.choice: "심판하다" (L, B); "다스리고 심판하다" (R)
decisions.reason: Judging here is ruling over and passing judgment on (meaning decision); Readable gives both.

decisions.choice: na renovação [de todas as coisas]
decisions.reason: The word means a rebirth of the world (m1). "Regeneração" now sounds technical or medical in Portuguese, so Literal says "renovação", with the words it needs in brackets, as the English does.

source.text: καὶ πᾶς ὅστις ἀφῆκεν οἰκίας ἢ ἀδελφοὺς ἢ ἀδελφὰς ἢ πατέρα ἢ μητέρα ἢ γυναῖκα ἢ τέκνα ἢ ἀγροὺς ἕνεκεν τοῦ ὀνόματός μου, ἑκατονταπλασίονα λήμψεται καὶ ζωὴν αἰώνιον κληρονομήσει.

records.literal_gloss: And everyone who left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or fields for the sake of the name of me, a hundredfold will receive and life eternal will inherit.

en.L: And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or fields for the sake of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name will receive a hundred times as much and will inherit eternal life.
en.B: Anyone who has left behind houses, or brothers or sisters, or father or mother, or wife or children, or fields, for the sake of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name will be repaid a hundred times over and will receive eternal life as an inheritance.
en.R: Some people have left their homes, their brothers or sisters, their father or mother, their wife or children, or their land, because they follow {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. They will get back a hundred times more than they left. And God will give them eternal life.

es.L: Y todo aquel que ha dejado casas o hermanos o hermanas o padre o madre o esposa o hijos o campos a causa de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, recibirá el céntuplo y heredará vida eterna.
es.B: Todo el que haya dejado atrás casas, o hermanos o hermanas, o padre o madre, o esposa o hijos, o campos, por causa de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, recibirá cien veces más y obtendrá como herencia la vida eterna.
es.R: Algunas personas han dejado sus casas, sus hermanos o hermanas, su padre o su madre, su esposa o sus hijos, o sus tierras, porque {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} siguen. Ellas recibirán cien veces más de lo que dejaron. Y Dios les dará la vida eterna.

fr.L: Et quiconque a laissé maisons, ou frères, ou sœurs, ou père, ou mère, ou femme, ou enfants, ou champs à cause de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom recevra cent fois plus et héritera de la vie éternelle.
fr.B: Quiconque aura quitté des maisons, des frères ou des sœurs, un père ou une mère, une femme ou des enfants, ou des terres, à cause de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, recevra cent fois plus et aura en héritage la vie éternelle.
fr.R: Certains ont quitté leur maison, leurs frères ou leurs sœurs, leur père ou leur mère, leur femme ou leurs enfants, ou leurs champs, parce qu’ils {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} suivent. Ils recevront cent fois plus que ce qu’ils ont laissé. Et Dieu leur donnera la vie éternelle.

sw.L: Na kila mmoja ambaye ameacha nyumba au kaka au dada au baba au mama au mke au watoto au mashamba kwa sababu ya jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, atapokea mara mia, naye atarithi uzima wa milele.
sw.B: Yeyote aliyeacha nyumba, au kaka au dada, au baba au mama, au mke au watoto, au mashamba, kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, atalipwa mara mia zaidi, naye atapewa uzima wa milele kuwa urithi wake.
sw.R: Watu wengine wameacha nyumba zao, kaka zao au dada zao, baba yao au mama yao, wake zao au watoto wao, au mashamba yao, kwa sababu wananifuata. Watapata mara mia zaidi ya walichoacha. Na Mungu atawapa uzima wa milele.

vi.L: Và mọi người đã bỏ nhà cửa, hoặc anh em, hoặc chị em, hoặc cha, hoặc mẹ, hoặc vợ, hoặc con cái, hoặc ruộng đất vì danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, sẽ nhận được gấp trăm lần và sẽ thừa hưởng sự sống đời đời.
vi.B: Ai đã bỏ nhà cửa, anh em, chị em, cha mẹ, vợ con hay ruộng đất vì danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} thì sẽ nhận lại gấp trăm lần, và sẽ được hưởng sự sống đời đời làm cơ nghiệp.
vi.R: Có những người đã bỏ nhà cửa, anh em, chị em, cha mẹ, vợ con hay ruộng vườn vì họ theo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Họ sẽ nhận lại gấp trăm lần những gì họ đã bỏ. Và Đức Chúa Trời sẽ ban cho họ sự sống đời đời.

ko.L: 그리고 내 이름 때문에 집이나 형제나 자매나 아버지나 어머니나 아내나 자녀나 밭을 버린 사람은 누구나 백 배를 받을 것이고, 영원한 생명을 상속받을 것이다.
ko.B: 누구든지 내 이름 때문에 집이나 형제나 자매나 아버지나 어머니나 아내나 자녀나 밭을 버린 사람은 백 배로 돌려받을 것이고, 영원한 생명을 유산으로 받을 것이다.
ko.R: 나를 따르기 때문에 자기 집이나 형제나 자매나 아버지나 어머니나 아내나 자녀나 땅을 떠난 사람들이 있다. 그런 사람은 누구나 자기가 떠난 것보다 백 배나 더 많이 받을 것이다. 그리고 하나님께서 그에게 영원한 생명을 주실 것이다.

pt.L: E todo aquele que deixou casas, ou irmãos, ou irmãs, ou pai, ou mãe, ou mulher, ou filhos, ou campos, por causa do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome receberá cem vezes mais e herdará a vida eterna.
pt.B: Quem deixou para trás casas, ou irmãos ou irmãs, ou pai ou mãe, ou mulher ou filhos, ou campos, por causa do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome será recompensado cem vezes mais e receberá a vida eterna como herança.
pt.R: Algumas pessoas deixaram a sua casa, os seus irmãos ou irmãs, o pai ou a mãe, a mulher ou os filhos, ou as suas terras, porque {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} seguem. Elas vão receber de volta cem vezes mais do que deixaram. E Deus vai dar a elas a vida eterna.

decisions.choice: for the sake of my name: because of me, for loyalty to me
alternatives: for the sake of a title
decisions.reason: A name stands for the person. Compare 10:22, "hated by all because of my name".

decisions.choice: a hundred times as much: far more than was given up, in the family of God's people
decisions.reason: Jesus calls those who do God's will his brothers, sisters and mother (12:49-50). Mark 10:30 says the reward comes "now in this time", together with eternal life in the age to come.

decisions.choice: inherit: receive as heirs, a gift and not a wage
decisions.reason: An inheritance is given because one belongs to the family. Compare 25:34.

decisions.choice: or wife and a hundred times, the readings of the SBLGNT
alternatives: no mention of a wife, in some early manuscripts
many times, in some early manuscripts
decisions.reason: Some early manuscripts lack "or wife", and some read "many times" for "a hundred times", as in Luke 18:30. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: two sentences, with the reward told after the list
decisions.reason: Readable breaks up the long list.

decisions.choice: God will give them eternal life
decisions.reason: Readable says who gives the inheritance.

decisions.choice: kaka ... dada
alternatives: ndugu wa kiume ... ndugu wa kike
decisions.reason: Here the Greek names brothers and sisters in the family, side by side, so Swahili uses the words that tell them apart, "kaka" and "dada". "Ndugu", used for fellow disciples in 18:15, covers both and would blur the list.

decisions.choice: "anh em, chị em" for brothers and sisters, with no gender span
decisions.reason: Brothers and sisters are both named in the Greek, so no setting applies; as in Mark 10:29.

decisions.choice: "thừa hưởng" (L); "được hưởng ... làm cơ nghiệp" (B)
decisions.reason: The verb is to inherit; Readable says God gives it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "내 이름 때문에" (L, B), "나를 따르기 때문에" (R); "상속받다" (L), "유산으로 받다" (B), "하나님께서 ... 주실 것이다" (R)
decisions.reason: For my name's sake is for loyalty to him (meaning decision). To inherit is to receive as heirs, a gift and not a wage (meaning decision): Literal keeps "상속받다" as the Korean Mark 10:17 does, Balanced says "as an inheritance", Readable names the giver.

source.text: πολλοὶ δὲ ἔσονται πρῶτοι ἔσχατοι καὶ ἔσχατοι πρῶτοι.

records.literal_gloss: Many but will be first last and last first.

en.L: But many [who are] first will be last, and [the] last first.
en.B: But many who are first now will end up last, and the last will end up first.
en.R: But many people who are important now will be the least important then. And many who are the least important now will be the most important then.

es.L: Pero muchos [que son] primeros serán últimos, y [muchos] últimos, primeros.
es.B: Pero muchos que ahora son primeros terminarán siendo los últimos, y los últimos terminarán siendo los primeros.
es.R: Pero muchas personas que ahora son importantes serán entonces las menos importantes. Y muchas que ahora son las menos importantes serán entonces las más importantes.

fr.L: Mais beaucoup [qui sont] premiers seront derniers, et les derniers [seront] premiers.
fr.B: Mais beaucoup de ceux qui sont maintenant les premiers finiront derniers, et les derniers finiront premiers.
fr.R: Mais beaucoup de gens qui sont importants maintenant seront alors les moins importants. Et beaucoup de ceux qui sont les moins importants maintenant seront alors les plus importants.

sw.L: Lakini wengi wa kwanza watakuwa wa mwisho, na wa mwisho [watakuwa] wa kwanza.
sw.B: Lakini wengi walio wa kwanza sasa wataishia kuwa wa mwisho, na wa mwisho wataishia kuwa wa kwanza.
sw.R: Lakini watu wengi walio muhimu sasa watakuwa wasio na umuhimu wakati huo. Na wengi wasio na umuhimu sasa watakuwa muhimu kuliko wote wakati huo.

vi.L: Nhưng nhiều người đứng đầu sẽ thành người cuối cùng, và những người cuối cùng [sẽ thành] người đứng đầu.
vi.B: Nhưng nhiều người đang đứng đầu sẽ trở thành người cuối cùng, và những người cuối cùng sẽ được đứng đầu.
vi.R: Nhưng nhiều người bây giờ đang quan trọng thì khi ấy sẽ trở thành kém quan trọng nhất. Và nhiều người bây giờ kém quan trọng nhất thì khi ấy sẽ trở thành quan trọng nhất.

ko.L: 그러나 첫째인 많은 사람이 꼴찌가 되고, 꼴찌인 [사람들이] 첫째가 될 것이다.
ko.B: 그러나 지금 첫째인 많은 사람이 꼴찌가 되고, 꼴찌인 사람들이 첫째가 될 것이다.
ko.R: 그러나 지금 높은 사람들 가운데 많은 사람이 그때에는 가장 낮아질 것이다. 그리고 지금 가장 낮은 사람들 가운데 많은 사람이 그때에는 가장 높아질 것이다.

pt.L: Mas muitos [que são] primeiros serão últimos, e [os] últimos, primeiros.
pt.B: Mas muitos que agora são os primeiros vão acabar sendo os últimos, e os últimos vão acabar sendo os primeiros.
pt.R: Mas muitas pessoas que agora são importantes vão ser as menos importantes naquele tempo. E muitas que agora são as menos importantes vão ser as mais importantes naquele tempo.

decisions.choice: first and last: those who rank high or low now will change places in the kingdom
alternatives: the order in which people enter heaven
decisions.reason: Those who seem first now, like the rich, may be last; those who seem last, like the disciples who gave everything up, will be first. The same saying ends the parable that follows (20:16).

decisions.choice: but: a warning that follows the promise
alternatives: a contrast with the young man only
decisions.reason: After promising reward, Jesus warns that rank in the kingdom will not follow the ranks of this world, even among his followers.

decisions.choice: important now ... least important then
decisions.reason: Readable says what first and last mean.
